quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology HKEX circular: Major and Connected Transaction in Relation (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Second Supplemental Master Supply Agreement with Luxshare Precision Industry (23 April 2026): annual caps for the Group's supply of cable products, medical equipment cables, copper wire products and server products to the Luxshare Precision group raised from HK$1,598,000,000, HK$1,758,000,000 and HK$1,934,000,000 to HK$3,497,000,000 (2026), HK$5,306,000,000 (2027) and HK$5,837,000,000 (2028). Actual supply was HK$212,081 thousand from 1 April to 31 December 2025 and HK$127,560 thousand in the two months to 28 February 2026. The increase reflects the Target Group (Leoni LCS Group), which supplies cable products as raw materials to the Luxshare Precision group: its highest monthly cable sales to that group between July 2025 and March 2026 were approximately EUR31.6 million, and the directors projected an eight-month 2026 demand of approximately HK$2,308 million after completion, with a 15% buffer and 10% organic year-on-year growth assumed for 2027 and 2028; the directors also cite the average copper price rising from USD9,945 per ton for FY2025 to an average of over USD12,500 per ton for the first quarter of 2026. Caps are ceilings, not sales.

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology HKEX circular: Major and Connected Transaction in Relation (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planned acquisition of the remaining 51% of Time Interconnect Singapore (held 49% by the Group and 51% by Luxshare Precision Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Luxshare Precision Industry) under a sale and purchase agreement dated 23 April 2026; on completion it becomes a wholly owned subsidiary consolidated by the Company. Time Interconnect Singapore acquired LEONI Kabel on 9 July 2025 and, through the Leoni LCS Group, develops, manufactures and sells copper cables transmitting power, signals and data for the automotive sector and other industries (from standardised to specialised and data cables, including charging cables for electric mobility); its major customers are mainly leading global automotive component suppliers, it has ten production facilities in China, Germany, Mexico, Poland, Hungary, Slovakia and Turkey with approximately 291,000 square meters of gross floor area, and Time Interconnect Singapore also runs a vehicle-parts trading business (approximately HK$69.7 million revenue in 2025). Board's reasons: copper wire from the DJC Group is a fundamental raw material of both groups' copper cable products, the Target Group's automotive cables are a major component of the Group's wire harness products, and its know-how in high-temperature-resistant materials and cooling technology for automotive and charging cables could be applied to other Group cables; the Group intends to use the Target Group's footprint in Europe and the Americas to reach more global customers. The Group itself has manufacturing facilities in Shanghai, Jiangsu, Jiangxi and Guangdong (PRC), Japan, Vietnam, Thailand and Mexico, and its customers include global network solutions and infrastructure providers, a global cloud service provider, a multinational medical equipment manufacturer and an automotive manufacturer.
quarterly_data.figure: Leoni LCS Group: ten production facilities, approximately 291,000 square meters

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology HKEX circular: Major and Connected Transaction in Relation (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Leoni LCS Group (Automotive Cable Solutions Business) audited FY2025: revenue HK$11,997,064 thousand (2024: HK$11,597,732 thousand; 2023: HK$12,436,350 thousand), of which automotive cables HK$10,781,829 thousand, charging cables HK$601,168 thousand and industry cables HK$614,067 thousand; by region EMEA HK$6,172,636 thousand, Americas HK$3,299,926 thousand, Asia Pacific HK$2,524,502 thousand; the increase came mainly from higher demand for charging cables and a stronger euro. Profit after tax HK$125,292 thousand versus a HK$598,446 thousand loss in 2024 (impairments recognised in 2024). Two customers each above 10% of revenue (Customer A HK$2,077,197 thousand, Customer B HK$1,235,943 thousand; not named); 3,249 employees at 31 December 2025; business operations in Halver were shut down during 2025. Time Interconnect Singapore's own consolidated FY2025 revenue (Leoni LCS Group from 9 July 2025) was HK$6,405,554 thousand, profit after tax HK$163,738 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Leoni LCS Group revenue HK$11,997,064 thousand; profit after tax HK$125,292 thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Time Interconnect Technology HKEX circular: Major and Connected Transaction in Relation (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Legal proceedings disclosed for the Leoni LCS Group / enlarged group: in January 2022 the German Federal Cartel Office (Bundeskartellamt) searched facilities as part of investigations against various cable manufacturers and other sector-related companies, on suspicion that cable manufacturers colluded on computing customary metal surcharges in Germany; the group continues to cooperate, the proceedings are still at the investigative stage, management considers the amount of obligation cannot be measured reliably and no provision is made. Several subsidiaries face other legal proceedings and potential claims of approximately EUR0.4 million in aggregate, with the risk of a material outflow considered remote.
quarterly_data.figure: Other claims approximately EUR0.4 million; cartel investigation unprovided
